description: FREE, deterministic. Estimates the Brazilian import tax on a cross-border purchase and the final landed price. Give the product value (and freight) EITHER in BRL integer cents (product_cents / freight_cents) OR in USD (product_usd / freight_usd) — not both — plus an optional buyer state `uf`. Returns the Import Tax (0% up to US$50, else 30% − US$20), the ICMS por-dentro by state, the total landed price, the USD rate used (Bacen PTAX) and the ruleset version. Rules follow MP 1.357/2026 and may change (~sep/2026); it is an estimate — the marketplace checkout is the source of truth. No payment.

freight_cents.description: Freight in BRL cents (part of the customs base).

insurance_cents.description: Insurance in BRL cents, if any.

product_cents.description: Product value in BRL cents (e.g. 30000 = R$300). Use the *_cents fields OR the *_usd fields, not both.

uf.description: Buyer's 2-letter Brazilian state (e.g. SP). Default: 20% ICMS ceiling.

name: calculate_import_taxes
title: Estimate Brazilian import tax & landed price (free)
